templates.why_chosen: Simple, single-flow host-device figure: shadow-stacked host boxes (implying N repeated hosts) sit symmetrically against one CXL memory-node box, joined by a single CXL Links arrow, though neither the host count nor request-vs-response direction is labeled.
templates.what_to_learn: A shadow-stacked box implies repetition even at nesting depth 2 with no lanes, but unlike this figure, label the stack with its count or an explicit N so the reader is not left guessing; also name what direction an interconnect arrow carries (request vs response) rather than leaving one plain arrow to mean everything.
